claim: Nvidia posted close to $67.5B in revenue in its fiscal 2024 filing
summary: NVIDIA's fiscal 2024 Form 10-K (year ended January 28, 2024) reported total revenue of ~$79.8B, not close to $67.5B. The $67.5B figure understates reported FY2024 revenue by ~$12.3B (~18%).

sub_claims.text: Nvidia filed a fiscal 2024 filing that reported revenue
sub_claims.stated_text: Nvidia posted ... in revenue in its fiscal 2024 filing
sub_claims.note: NVIDIA filed a FY2024 10-K for the year ended January 28, 2024 that includes audited revenue.

sub_claims.text: Nvidia's fiscal 2024 revenue was close to $67.5 billion
sub_claims.note: Without tools, based on existing knowledge: FY2024 revenue was $79.774B per the 10-K, not ~$67.5B; difference is far outside any reasonable 'close to' tolerance for approx.
